from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROUTES = ROOT / 'backend' / 'modules' / 'inteligencia_comercial' / 'iscam_routes.py'


def _block(text, start, end):
    return text[text.index(start):text.index(end)]


def test_detail_endpoints_filter_canonical_table_by_unit_code_not_uuid():
    text = ROUTES.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    products = _block(text, 'async def ventas_periodos_productos', 'async def ventas_periodos_tickets')
    tickets = _block(text, 'async def ventas_periodos_tickets', '# ============================================================================\n# 2) RESUMEN DE CUENTAS')
    accounts = _block(text, 'async def resumen_cuentas', 'async def cuenta_detalle')
    account_detail = _block(text, 'async def cuenta_detalle', '# ============================================================================\n# 3) COMANDAS DE VENTA')
    comandas = _block(text, 'async def comandas_venta', '# ============================================================================\n# 4) VENTAS POR FORMAS DE PAGO')
    for block in (products, tickets, account_detail, comandas):
        assert 'resolver_codigo(unidad)' in block
        assert 'str(unidad_pk)' not in block
    direct_accounts = accounts[accounts.rindex('unidad_codigo = UnidadesService.resolver_codigo(unidad)'):]
    assert 'str(unidad_pk)' not in direct_accounts
    assert 'unidad_codigo' in direct_accounts


def test_header_kpi_paths_keep_real_pk_contract():
    text = ROUTES.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    header = _block(text, 'async def ventas_periodos(', 'async def ventas_periodos_productos')
    grouped_accounts = _block(text, 'async def resumen_cuentas', 'unidad_codigo = UnidadesService.resolver_codigo(unidad)')
    assert 'resolver_pk(unidad)' in header
    assert 'unidad_pks=[str(unidad_pk)]' in header
    assert 'resolver_pk(unidad)' in grouped_accounts
    assert 'unidad_pks=[str(unidad_pk)]' in grouped_accounts
